$comment: The custom outline shapes of sgs/icon (icon plan D2, Phase D): a fixed list, each one SVG path in a 0 0 100 100 viewBox that touches the box's edges. PHP reads it through includes/helpers-icon.php::sgs_icon_outline_shapes(); the editor imports it through src/utils/icon-shapes.js. The box shapes (square, circle, pill) are drawn by icon/style.css and are not listed here. Per entry: slug (the `shape` enum value), label (the inspector's name for it), d (the path). The star points up, fills the box's width and is drawn about the box's centre (its circumcentre, 50 50), so its top point touches the top edge and its lower points stop short of the bottom; its inner radius is 0.55 of its outer radius, which keeps a centred glyph up to 31.5% of the shape's size inside its inner pentagon (icon/style.css gives the star a default size of 3.2 times the icon for that reason). render.php draws the path behind the glyph with its stroke inside the path (twice the border width, clipped to the path), so a path may run to the viewBox edge.
